title: HtmlH5
responsibility: Renders the native h5 element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlH5.attributes
inputs.description: Native h5 attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlH5.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native h5 element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlH5
outputs.description: The actual native h5 element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
